what: EnergyPlus as an independent reference on DOE prototype buildings
findings: pip index: no package named energyplus on PyPI (16 Nov 2026)

openstudio 3.11.0 wheel (79 MB) contains the OpenStudio SDK and the IDF forward translator (openstudio/_openstudioenergyplus.so) but no EnergyPlus simulation engine (no libenergyplusapi / energyplus executable)
EnergyPlus GitHub releases are blocked from this sandbox (coordinator note)
substitute: EnergyPlus-based references used instead: ResStock (OpenStudio-HPXML) and ComStock (OpenStudio) twins with identical weather; BESTEST ranges from the ASHRAE 140 reference programs
